diagnosis.definition: The agent handles a support or security request but leaves out a required part of the escalation procedure: the security@acme.example contact, the correct ticket priority (urgent), or a ticket reference (T-...). The reply sounds helpful but does not meet the task contract.

The agent ends the turn without calling create_ticket, either telling the user to ask HR or a manager when policy search finds nothing, or asking permission to file a ticket, so no ticket ID ("T-...") is produced as the task requires.

The assistant gives a policy answer, often with the right content, but omits the required bracketed policy citation (e.g. [P-02]) or the ticket ID the task contract demands, so the answer fails the format check.
The assistant answers a policy question and mentions the policy ID in prose (e.g. 'policy P-12') but omits the required bracketed citation tag '[P-12]' that the task contract demands in the answer.
